fusions.name: Salmon Gaff
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A hooked swipe that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Displacement
fusions.desc: Drops your full weight into the water. The wave it throws deals 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Fat of the Run
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and you restore 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Wintered Reserve
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
